title: HPP Challenge Response
description: A signed challenge issued by the HPP Attestation Server in response to GET /v1/challenge. The client MUST verify server_sig and freshness before using the challenge for WebAuthn authentication.

nonce.description: 32 bytes, base64url-encoded, single-use. Becomes the WebAuthn challenge parameter and binds the resulting assertion to this specific challenge. The server MUST reject any attestation carrying a nonce that has already been consumed.

rp_id.description: eTLD+1 (registrable domain) of the requesting site. Must match the WebAuthn rp.id used in the credential.get() call. Computed server-side from the origin; never trusted from client input.

server_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Authoritative server time at challenge issuance. This is the time anchor for the H-Constant enforcement window — not the client device clock.

window_ms.description: NPHT enforcement window in milliseconds. The minimum wall-clock time the server requires between challenge issuance and attestation submission. Derived from the H-Constant: window_ms >= H_min, where H_min is the platform authenticator's minimum biometric interaction latency (TPM 2.0 floor: ~800ms; Secure Enclave floor: ~600ms). This is NOT an arbitrary timeout — it is the server-enforced biological cost floor.

purpose.description: Challenge purpose. 'attest' for login/presence verification flows. 'enrollment' for initial device registration.

server_sig.description: ECDSA P-256 signature over the canonical challenge payload (nonce, rp_id, server_timestamp, window_ms, purpose — keys sorted alphabetically, JSON.stringify with no whitespace). The client MUST verify this signature against the pinned HPP Attestation Server public key before proceeding with WebAuthn.

verification_procedure.description: Steps the client MUST execute before using a challenge for WebAuthn.

steps.detail: Verify server_sig is a valid ECDSA P-256 signature over the canonical payload. Canonical payload: JSON.stringify with keys in alphabetical order (nonce, purpose, rp_id, server_timestamp, window_ms), no extra whitespace.
Compute abs(Date.now() - server_timestamp). If greater than max_clock_skew_ms (from /v1/config), the challenge is stale or the clock is unacceptably skewed.
steps.failure_action: Reject challenge. Error: HPP_CHALLENGE_STALE or HPP_CLOCK_SKEW

steps.detail: Verify purpose matches the intended flow ('attest' for login, 'enrollment' for registration).
